verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair axis for an AI-native email product, but the evidence shows no documented CLI, headless mode, or public API; the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The MCP server (driven from Claude or ChatGPT) and trigger-based agents belong to other stories, so they earn no credit here. Every send through AI assistants also requires explicit user approval, which works against unattended pipeline automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
